# Muzzey's Smiles

> > Combined pediatric dentistry and orthodontics practice in Lexington, MA offering specialized care for children and families with a child-friendly approach.

Muzzey's Smiles (Coppe + Sears) is a pediatric dental and orthodontic practice in Lexington, Massachusetts led by Drs. Michael and Carolyn Coppe and Dr. Chad Sears. The practice specializes in children's dental care, orthodontics including Invisalign, and special needs dentistry with an emphasis on creating positive first dental experiences.
